content_of_post_to_comment: The most dangerous myth is that women stay in toxic relationships because they do not understand their own lives. The truth is many women understand too much. They understand the real estate market, the court system, the way police shrug at “domestic issues,” the way friends fade away, the way children become bargaining chips. They fully understand the trap because they live in it every day.
comment: The hardest part may be that leaving requires resources a person often loses while surviving: money, networks, credibility, even a sense of what a safe future looks like. Awareness alone doesn't create an exit.
